regulations.notes: Within Park City municipal limits, STRs are primarily permitted in resort zones (Canyons Village, Kimball Junction/Redstone/Newpark). Summit County Nightly Rental Licenses cost $350 annually; both owners and property managers must hold one for nightly rentals under 30 days. Utah has no statewide STR license — regulation is entirely local. State-level sales tax compliance is required through the Utah State Tax Commission.
